content.title: P3a content gates
content.units: kb.content.frontmatter (the gate half; the parser half landed in P2), kb.content.page-shape, kb.content.docs-map, kb.content.rule-identity, kb.gates.link-integrity (the repo half; the site half is the site lane's)
content.scenarios: content-O1, content-O2, content-O3, docs-map-O1, frontmatter-O1, page-shape-O1, link-integrity-O1 (repo half)
content.brief:
Kit sources to copy with the renames: kit/tools/src/gates/check-doc-frontmatter.ts, check-docs-style.ts, check-docs-map.ts and their tests; kit/tools/src/gen for the map generator. The repo half of link integrity reads links in docs/**.md and the harness markdown and must import tools/src/lib/links.ts (P4a extracted it), never copy it.
The KB's own page rules become ONE kb-shape gate reading docs/data/content-model.json and tools/src/lib/kb-attrs.ts: block order per kind (a page's kind is its top area), required and optional blocks, the closed suffix keys and values ({level=advanced|expert}, {#id}), closed section-fact keys (block, polarity, requirement) and values, sketch languages, area = folder, unique slugs, exactly one H1 equal to the title, an intro paragraph before the first H2, no H4.
docs/reference/page-rules.md is the rule-identity page: one row per rule, row id = rule id with an anchor — PAGE-001..008 from the spec's page-shape unit and KB-0nn for this KB's own rules (suffix grammar, lens values, block order per kind, polarity, requirement, sketch languages, …) — each row naming the gate that decides it. Gates cite these ids in their findings (`<RULE-ID> <file>:<line> <message>`).
Whatever these gates find on the 382 converted pages is fixed at the ROOT: in the converter / dialect (then `make all`; RT-1 must stay green and must not be weakened) when the conversion is wrong, or in site/ when the source is wrong. Two known source fixes: F24 — the essences of amazon-locker, elevator, logging-service and inventory-management are over 160 characters (shorten each in the site page's data-kb-essence, keeping its meaning, plain words); F25 — aggregate has 6 solves (keep the best 5 with `node scripts/kb.mjs set aggregate --solves '[…]'`).
The hand-written docs pages (docs/reference/*.md, docs/concepts/*.md, docs/inbox.md, docs/README.md) must pass the same frontmatter gate, so the structure file needs an area for them: add a `reference` area through its own extractor module called from extract-model.ts (the structure file is generated until the cutover), and move docs/concepts/* under docs/reference/ if that is the cleanest home (update every link; context-layers, claims and gates-fresh must stay green). docs/README.md is the docs map: a generated marked block lists every page by area; gen-map writes it, the docs-map gate holds it.

steps.title: frontmatter gate, kb-shape gate, page-rules.md, the reference area
steps.prompt: Build the frontmatter gate (kit copy, renamed, reading through the one parser), the kb-shape gate and docs/reference/page-rules.md; add the reference area for the hand-written pages. Run both gates over the real tree and fix every finding at its root (converter/dialect or site/), keeping RT-1 green. Scenarios frontmatter-O1 and page-shape-O1 by id.

steps.title: docs-style gate, the docs map, the repo link gate, editorial F24/F25
steps.prompt: Build the docs-style gate, the docs map (docs/README.md with its generated block, gen-map, the docs-map gate) and the repo half of the link gate; fix every finding at its root; do F24 and F25 in site/ then `make all`. Scenarios content-O1..O3, docs-map-O1 and link-integrity-O1 (repo half) by id.

verify.prompt:
## Content fidelity
Every converter or dialect change this lane made must lose nothing: run RT-1 and read `git diff 4ca79c1 -- tools/src/migrate docs/` (the docs diff is large; sample 25 changed pages across kinds and compare each change against its site source). Check the F24 essences still say what they said and are at most 160 characters, and the aggregate solves kept the five best. Report any lost word, id, lens tag or link.

tags.title: P3b structure and tags gates, tag facets, the retag
tags.scenarios: data-O1, data-O2, structure-O3, tags-O2 (read data-O1 and data-O2 in oracle.md; if one belongs to another lane's unit, say so and leave it)
tags.brief:
Kit sources to copy with the renames: kit/tools/src/gates/check-site-structure.ts, lib/published.ts, check-tags.ts, gen/gen-taxonomy.ts, lib/tags.ts and their tests.
Tag facets (spec tree/data/tags): `topic` says what the page is about and is the hub grouping key — an ordinary page carries EXACTLY ONE topic, first; `skill` says what the reader does; `language` names the machinery. Values run in facet order. Topics carry a `label`. The plan's first cut is ~20 topics (resilience, caching, messaging, concurrency, consistency, security, observability, persistence, replication, partitioning, transactions, routing, api-design, domain-modeling, data-modeling, ui-architecture, machine-learning, testing, integration, event-driven), ~38 skills, and language = cloud, edge — decide from the real usage of the 60 tags. Until the cutover the facets and topic labels live in scripts/lib/model.mjs TAGS / TAG_DESC (tags.json is generated from it by extract-model); keep the existing rules: 2-5 tags per page, every tag on 3+ pages, the closed set enforced by `kb.mjs set --tags` and audit-vocab. The flat TAGS tuple lives at site/src/lib/types.ts — this lane owns that file and writes only the tuple (the site lane will not create it); the tags gate checks tuple and list both ways.
The retag: every page ends with exactly one topic, first, and all tags in facet order. Pages whose answer is mechanical (reorder only) are done in step 1; pages with 0 or 2+ topics need an editorial pick, done in the fan-out through `node scripts/kb.mjs set <id> --tags '[…]'`, then `make all` once. F23: themes/event-storming and themes/event-modeling carry no tags — give them honest ones. F9: six hazards lost their hand-written 'Anti-pattern' kicker in the conversion (ledger entry hazard-anti-pattern-kickers) — decide whether a closed tag honestly carries that classification (3+ pages); if it does, tag them and take the entry out of known-losses.json only if RT-1 no longer needs it (never widen a match). In the spec the topic is the hub grouping key; this KB's hub groups by area — record how the two relate for the site lane (report it; do not build hubs). RT-1 compares against the working tree's graph.json, so after `make all` it stays green through a retag; confirm it.

steps.title: structure gate, tags gate + taxonomy page, the facet design, mechanical reorders
steps.prompt: Build the structure gate (with lib/published) and the tags gate with gen-taxonomy and docs/reference/tags.md; design the facets in model.mjs; write site/src/lib/types.ts; reorder the pages whose fix is mechanical; count every page's topics. Commit.
steps.batches: the editorial retag worklist — every page with 0 or 2+ topics (and F23's two pages; F9's six hazards if you decided a tag carries it) — split into at most 10 batches grouped by area, each object holding {area, facet_design (topics with labels and a one-line meaning each, skills, languages), rule, pages: [{id, current_tags, topic_candidates}]}

steps.title: editorial retag
steps.prompt: For each page in your batch: read it through the reader (`node scripts/kb.mjs get <id> --block description` and `--block explain`; never open the .html), pick the ONE topic that says what the page is about (the concern it files under), keep 2-5 honest tags in facet order (topic, skills, languages), only from the closed set, and write them with `node scripts/kb.mjs set <id> --tags '[…]'`. Do not invent tags and do not edit model.mjs.

steps.title: regenerate, green gates, commit the retag
steps.prompt: Run `make all` once; make the tags and structure gates green over the real tree (fix leftovers with kb.mjs set); check audit-vocab's 3+ pages and 2-5 tags rules still hold; RT-1 green. Commit the retag one commit per area (site pages + their regenerated docs pages and data files; exact paths). Scenarios data-O1, data-O2, structure-O3, tags-O2 by id.

verify.prompt:
## Editorial audit of the retag
Sample 40 retagged pages across every area (`git diff 4ca79c1 --stat -- site/`). For each, read the page's description through `node scripts/kb.mjs get <id> --block description` and judge: is the topic the one concern the page files under; are the other tags honest; is anything lost that the old tags said. Report each bad pick with the better one.

vocab.title: P3b vocabulary: glossary, ban gate, exceptions, products, search synonyms
vocab.units: kb.data.glossary, kb.data.exceptions; KB extensions: products.json with the products gate (offline half), search-synonyms.json, the ban gate
vocab.brief:
Kit sources to copy with the renames: kit/tools/src/gates/check-vocabulary.ts, gen/gen-vocabulary.ts and their tests.
glossary.json follows the spec's glossary unit (terms with definitions; `avoid` entries naming the word to use instead). Its KB content comes from model.mjs (KINDS, BLOCK_DESC, the relation verb glosses, POLARITIES, LEVELS, JSONLD_PROPS) — until the cutover that half is generated by a NEW extractor module called from extract-model.ts — and from .claude/rules/tone.md's 'Cut on sight' table, which becomes mechanical through the ban gate. Decide where the avoid list's single source lives (one home per fact; tone.md then points at it) and record the choice. The reference page docs/reference/glossary.md is generated and stamped.
Add the owner's two retired word families to the avoid list: mint / minted / minting (use issue or generate) and derive / derived / derivable (use computed, rebuilt by replay, worked out, or subclass — the replacement is sense-specific, never a blind swap). The ban gate reads prose in docs/**.md (not code spans, fences, frontmatter keys or identifiers) and the harness markdown (every CLAUDE.md layer, .claude/rules, .claude/skills, .claude/agents); decide whether plans/ is in scope and record it. Every hit on the real tree when the gate lands is fixed at its source: page prose in site/ (writer-owned blocks explain/production/wild through `node scripts/kb.mjs explain|production|wild`, dumping the current block with `get <id> --block <b> --json` first so no level tag or <code> is lost; direct HTML text edits elsewhere; never a kb:generated region), harness text directly. A fix is a plain, sense-specific rewrite that keeps the meaning exactly.
exceptions: the allowlist format under docs/data/allow/ (P1 and P4a already use two) per the spec's exceptions unit. products.json from scripts/lib/products.mjs (a new extractor) with the offline half of audit-products as a registered gate (the network re-fetch stays `make products`). search-synonyms.json from SYNONYMS in model.mjs + scripts/data/expansion-synonyms.json (a new extractor); clear the stale expansion-synonyms stamp WARN in make check with its documented repair.

steps.title: glossary, vocabulary and ban gates, exceptions, products, synonyms
steps.prompt: Build glossary.json and its extractor, the vocabulary gate, gen-vocabulary and docs/reference/glossary.md, the ban gate, the exceptions unit, products.json + products gate, search-synonyms.json; fix every harness-text hit of the ban gate directly. Measure the ban gate's hits in site pages (through the docs pages that mirror them). Commit.
steps.batches: the page-prose worklist — at most 10 batches grouped by page (never split a page across batches), each object {pages: [{id, site_file, hits: [{docs_line, word, sentence, block}]}], replacements (the avoid list rows that apply)}

steps.title: plain-word rewrites in site pages
steps.prompt: For each hit in your batch, rewrite that sentence in the SITE page (never the docs page) so the avoided word is gone and the meaning is exactly kept — sense-specific, plain, in the house tone (second person, active voice, one idea per sentence). Writer-owned blocks (explain, production, wild) go through their kb.mjs writer after dumping the block with `--json`; everything else is a direct text edit of the HTML outside any kb:generated region. A term of art that must stay (a quoted product or API name) is reported, not rewritten.

steps.title: regenerate, ban gate green, commit
steps.prompt: Run `make all` once; make the ban gate and the vocabulary gate green over the real tree (finish leftovers); RT-1 green (RT-1 reads the working tree, so reworded prose stays equal on both sides after `make all`). Commit the rewrites grouped by area (site pages + regenerated docs pages; exact paths). Scenarios glossary-O1 and exceptions-O1 by id.

verify.prompt:
## Prose fidelity
Read every sentence the lane rewrote (`git diff 4ca79c1 -- site/`, word-diff) and judge each: same meaning, plainer, correct sense for the replacement, house tone. Report every changed meaning, awkward replacement, lost <code>/<strong>/link, or edit inside a kb:generated region.

relations.title: P3c + P6a relations, learning paths, prerequisites, maturity
relations.units: kb.data.learning-paths (the gate half), kb.learning.prerequisites, kb.learning.maturity, kb.generation.marked-blocks (real tree); KB extension: the relations gate
relations.scenarios: learning-paths-O1, learning-O1, learning-O2, maturity-O1, prerequisites-O1, marked-blocks-O1 (real tree), generation-O2; learning-O3 only if it needs no built site (otherwise report it for wave 2)
relations.brief:
The relations gate reads docs/data/relations.json: the 17 closed paired verbs (variant-of/has-variant, prevents-hazard/mitigated-by, demonstrates/demonstrated-by, implements, prerequisite, …; see scripts/lib/model.mjs RELATION_TYPES and REL_ORDER), pairing that is structural, no dangling target, no one-way or contradictory edge, groups and maps honoured — it replaces legacy audit-relations at the cutover (a cutover note), and it must agree with audit-relations on today's tree. The learning-paths gate reads docs/data/learning-paths.json: every stage a route the structure file produces, profiles, notes, no orphan note.
prerequisites.json is a GENERATED second form of relations.json (root-C3 allows a gated-equal second form): `requires` = the prerequisite verb, `related` = the symmetric verbs, label/definition/route from each page's title, description and structure row. gen-prerequisites writes it and a stamped docs/reference/prerequisites.md; the prerequisites gate holds it acyclic, resolved, reciprocal, with no orphan.
maturity: `status` is required on every page with a closed value set and no default (every page is `stable` today); the gate and the frontmatter rule land here.
The gen-relations and gen-tours CLIs wrap tools/src/lib/render-relations.ts and render-tours.ts once the data files become the source: build and test them now, but do NOT register them — before the cutover the converter writes those marked blocks and convert-fresh holds them (dialect X-22); put their registration in cutover_notes. marked-blocks-O1 and generation-O2 are proven on the real tree.
F1: active-record and transaction-script draw anemic-domain-model in their hand-drawn neighbour figures with no typed edge. Decide the honest verb and write it with `node scripts/kb.mjs link` (both pages), or leave it and say why; if you link, lower the `neighbour-diagram-non-edges` ledger count to match (never widen a match), then `make all`.

steps.title: relations gate, learning-paths gate, F1
steps.prompt: Build the relations gate and the learning-paths gate (five pieces each), prove them against today's tree and against audit-relations, do F1. Scenario learning-paths-O1 by id. Commit.

steps.title: prerequisites, maturity, marked blocks on the real tree, the P3c CLIs
steps.prompt: Build prerequisites.json + gen-prerequisites + docs/reference/prerequisites.md + the prerequisites gate, the maturity gate, the gen-relations/gen-tours CLIs (tested, not registered), and the real-tree proofs for marked-blocks-O1 and generation-O2. Scenarios learning-O1, learning-O2, maturity-O1, prerequisites-O1 (and learning-O3 if it needs no site) by id. Commit.

harness.title: P4b harness: self-check gates, kit skills and agents, records, the 46 skills reshaped
harness.units: kb.harness.self-check, kb.harness.skills-and-agents, kb.harness.truth-sweep (its skill, agent, schedule and records), kb.content.rule-identity for tone.md (TONE ids only; page-rules.md is the content lane's)
harness.scenarios: harness-O1, harness-O2 (in full now), self-check-O1, skills-and-agents-O1, skills-and-agents-O3
harness.brief:
Start from the P4b block in plans/harness-optimize.md Status (P4a's hand-off). Kit sources: kit/tools/src/gates/check-harness.ts (drop its artifact-linter call) and the kit's .claude/skills and .claude/agents.
The self-check shape gate: the harness folder list, rule shape through tools/src/lib/rules.ts, hooks executable and silent on empty input, settings.json wiring, then skill and agent shapes. The route gate: every harness link resolves and the untracked table holds; today it would be red on dead links in kb-design-levels and kb-design-relationships and on tmp/ routes in kb-fact-check, kb-harvest, kb-intake, site-extract and sys-design — fix those at the source.
Add and adapt the kit skills retire-gotcha (the inbox's retirement skill, trap-inbox-C9/C10), docs-sweep (the truth-sweep skill), gate-red, page-audit, site-audit and site-component (these two serve the Astro site the site lane is building; write them against the spec and the kit, true once the site exists), and the verifier agents claim-audit and gate-triage (Read/Glob/Grep only). Add the sweep's CI schedule and docs/records/ (its row in docs/README.md is a one-line hunk; the content lane owns that file's generator — if the map is generated, report the row instead of hand-writing it).
TONE ids in .claude/rules/tone.md (one id per rule, anchored). Re-point the stale lines docs/inbox.md names (three pointers to rules the root no longer holds; the fourteen skill and brief lines that say a hook runs a check after each edit — site/assets/CLAUDE.md retires at the cutover instead) and retire the inbox entries that close through retire-gotcha's procedure.
Reshape ALL 46 existing skills to the spec's skill shape: description 'Use when… / Not for…', body = the gap → numbered steps → 'Done means'. Every instruction must stay TRUE for today's repo (HTML source, kb.mjs v1, make all / make check): the content re-point to docs/ and kb.mjs v2 happens at the cutover, in wave 2. Existing non-verifier agents keep Bash for kb.mjs (a recorded deviation from skills-and-agents-C4). lint-claude.mjs must stay green (it warns once per skill no CLAUDE.md names). permissions.allow (self-check-C10) is the OWNER's decision: add no allow entries; report the list the harness would need.
Only this lane edits root CLAUDE.md (586/600 words).

steps.title: self-check gates, kit skills and agents, records, TONE ids, stale pointers
steps.prompt: Build the self-check shape and route gates (five pieces each), add the kit skills and agents, docs/records/ and the sweep schedule, TONE ids, fix the stale pointers and retire the inbox entries that close. Run the skill-shape half over the 46 existing skills and measure what each lacks. Scenarios harness-O1, harness-O2, self-check-O1 by id. Commit.
steps.batches: the skill reshape worklist — the 46 existing skills in batches of about 5, grouped by family (kb-design-*, kb-*-blocks, style-*, …), each object {skills: [{name, path, gaps}], shape_rules (the exact description and body shape the gate enforces, with one finished example skill path to copy the form from)}

steps.title: reshape skills to the spec shape
steps.prompt: Reshape each skill in your batch to the shape rules: description 'Use when… / Not for…' (a routing trigger, keep its trigger words), body = the gap it closes → numbered steps → 'Done means'. Keep EVERY instruction, command, path and reference the skill has today and keep it true for today's repo (HTML pages under site/ are the source; kb.mjs v1; make all / make check). Move nothing out of references/ files unless the shape demands it. Edit only your batch's SKILL.md files and their own references/.

steps.title: skill-shape gate green, lint green, commit
steps.prompt: Make the skill-shape gate and the route gate green on all skills (finish leftovers), lint-claude and context-layers green; spot-check five reshaped skills against `git show 4ca79c1:<path>` for lost instructions. Scenarios skills-and-agents-O1 and skills-and-agents-O3 by id. Commit one commit per skill family.

verify.prompt:
## Skill fidelity
Sample 15 reshaped skills across families and diff each against `git show 4ca79c1:<path>`: every instruction, command, path, rule and reference must survive and stay true for today's repo; the description must still route (trigger words kept); 'Done means' must be checkable. Report every lost or falsified instruction.

site.title: P5 site build (no cutover): Astro + Starlight, pagedata, components, map pages, search, RT-2
site.units: kb.pagedata.two-layers, kb.site.offline, kb.site.components, kb.site.build-command, kb.generation.mirror-and-hubs, kb.generation.output-ownership (site half), kb.pagedata.head, kb.pagedata.blocks, kb.pagedata.manifest, kb.pagedata.search, kb.gates.link-integrity (site half)
site.scenarios: site-O1, site-O2, site-O3, build-command-O1 (all but the five noise-gate lines, which come with P7), components-O1, offline-O1, pagedata-O1, blocks-O1, head-O1, manifest-O1, search-O1, two-layers-O1, mirror-and-hubs-O1, output-ownership-O1, link-integrity-O1 (site half)
site.brief:
The Astro + Starlight workspace lives under site/ BESIDE today's HTML until the cutover: site/package.json, site/astro.config.mjs, site/tsconfig.json, site/src/** — copy the kit's kit/site workspace with the renames (AudienceBadge → LevelBadge) and the kit's tools for it (gen-site-docs, gen-site-hubs, site-portable with its page-data passes, gen-search-index, check-site-portable, check-site-links, check-site-tokens, check-site-hooks). The tags lane owns site/src/lib/types.ts (the TAGS tuple): do NOT create that file; put any other shared types in another module and import the tuple from '../lib/types' only once it exists (until then read tags from docs/data/tags.json). Root package.json workspaces gains "site"; every dependency pinned exactly; every install script denied in allowScripts (record any that must run and why). Legacy `make all` / `make check` must stay green: their site/**.html globs must skip site/src, site/dist, site/.astro and site/node_modules; the mirror (site/src/content/docs) is ignored build input. `make site-build` is the build command.
Routes keep today's paths (patterns/distributed/resilience/circuit-breaker.html) through an explicit per-row route and build.format 'file', so every inbound link survives; the site must open from file:// (offline unit).
Two layers: facts are bare data-* attributes on class-free elements; data-kb-* is only a hook attribute. A remark/rehype kb-attrs plugin (reusing tools/src/lib/kb-attrs.ts) turns suffixes and section facts into bare data-* (data-level, data-block, data-polarity, …), sets a block heading's id to its block name so #tradeoffs anchors survive, and wraps classed Starlight nodes (code frames, figures) in a class-free div. Page difficulty `level` vs lens `data-level` collide on the value `advanced`: scope lens CSS inside [data-page] and record the rule.
KB components: Lens (the cumulative basic ⊂ advanced ⊂ expert toggle, a data-kb-lens hook, CSS scoped inside [data-page]), LevelBadge, Favourites (localStorage kb-favourites-v1 overrides over the authored favourite, as site/assets/favourites.js does today), Practiced, Facets, GraphExplorer (d3 from npm over a JSON data island) on the map/graph page, and the map/stack page (pattern → product, from the capability mapping tables and products). Neighbour diagrams in relationships blocks and the 'Mentioned by' aside are built from relations.json and prose links (today's pages show what they must look like). Mermaid → inline SVG at build (rehype-mermaid inline-svg with Playwright Chromium; cache it): first prove that SVG click links survive the portability pass; if Chromium cannot be installed here, fall back to the in-repo client-side mermaid (site/assets/vendor) and record the deviation.
Search: find today's relevance fixture (scripts/ or tests/), build the spec's payload (search-C*), measure the spec's ranking against this KB's scorer on the fixture, and keep the winner as ONE implementation in tools/src/lib/ that the kbcli lane's kb.mjs v2 will import at the merge — report its API in merge_notes.
RT-2: `roundtrip.ts --built site/dist` reads the manifest, article data blocks and section facts from the built site and compares like RT-1; register it. Do NOT delete anything under site/ and do not flip the source — the cutover is wave 3. pages.yml stays as it is.

steps.title: workspace, mirror, hubs, routes, build command, two-layers plugin, offline
steps.prompt: Stand up the site workspace, gen-site-docs (the mirror), gen-site-hubs (from docs/data/site-structure.json), the routes, `make site-build`, the kb-attrs remark/rehype plugin and the offline portability pass; build all 382 pages and open a sample from file://. Keep legacy make all / make check green. Scenarios two-layers-O1, offline-O1, mirror-and-hubs-O1 by id. Commit.

steps.title: head, blocks, manifest, the site gates, RT-2
steps.prompt: Build the page-data layer (head, blocks, manifest), register the site gates (portable, links, tokens, hooks) with five pieces each, and RT-2 over site/dist. Scenarios pagedata-O1, head-O1, blocks-O1, manifest-O1, output-ownership-O1, link-integrity-O1 (site half) by id. Commit.

steps.title: components, neighbour diagrams, mentions, map pages, mermaid SVG
steps.prompt: Build Lens, LevelBadge, Favourites, Practiced, Facets, the neighbour diagrams and 'Mentioned by' from data, the map/graph page with GraphExplorer and the map/stack page, and mermaid as inline SVG (or the recorded fallback). Scenario components-O1 by id. Commit.

steps.title: search, site scenarios, full proof
steps.prompt: Build search (payload, the scorer measurement, the one shared implementation), then prove site-O1..O3, search-O1 and build-command-O1 (minus the noise lines) by id; a full `make site-build`, RT-2 green, every gate green. Commit.

verify.prompt:
## The built site, as a reader meets it
Build with `make site-build` in your worktree. Using Playwright if it is installed (or reading the built HTML), open from file:// the built circuit-breaker, outbox, cap-theorem (theme), deadlock (hazard), storage (capability), one comparison and one design page, the hub and map/graph: check the lens toggle shows basic ⊂ advanced ⊂ expert as today's site does, favourites persist, the graph renders from its data island, search answers 'my thread pool is exhausted', every internal link resolves, and each page's text matches its site/**.html source. Report every difference a reader would notice.

kbcli.title: P4b kb.mjs v2 over docs/, held to v1 by a parity test
kbcli.units: none directly — kb.mjs v2 is the plan's P4b reader/writer over the markdown source; it serves every unit that reads pages
kbcli.scenarios: none by id; the existing relevance fixture must pass through v2's find, and the parity test is this lane's proof
kbcli.brief:
Build tools/src/kb/ with the SAME command surface as scripts/kb.mjs — scripts/lib/cli-spec.mjs is its spec; read scripts/kb.mjs and its tests fully first. Read commands (find, get [--block, --level, --json], related, ls, brief, refs, validate, and any other read command cli-spec lists) read docs/**.md and docs/data/*.json through tools/src/lib/frontmatter.ts and tools/src/lib/kb-attrs.ts: the lens through the suffix levels (cumulative, as v1's --level), blocks through section facts, relations through relations.json, tours and fluency through learning-paths.json, ids through kb-attrs' element ids so citations like #tradeoffs-con-2 keep working. Write commands (set → frontmatter; link/unlink → relations.json and both pages' relationships blocks through tools/src/lib/render-relations.ts; explain/production/wild → the block's markdown in the dialect of tools/src/migrate/dialect.md; level → the element's suffix by its id; new → a scaffold from content-model.json and a structure row) — `register` is retired. Before the cutover docs/ is generated from site/, so write commands are tested in sandbox trees only (tools/src/lib/sandbox.ts, fixtures) and never run against the real docs/; the launcher scripts/kb.mjs is NOT switched (a cutover note).
The parity test is the proof: for every read command and a sample of at least 40 ids across all seven kinds (every --block value, every --level, --json), v1 (`node scripts/kb.mjs … --json` over site/) and v2 (over docs/) must return the same knowledge. Each difference is fixed, or is exactly a loss RT-1's ledger already decided (name the entry). `find` must pass the existing relevance fixture (find it); keep ranking behind one function so the site lane's shared scorer can replace it at the merge. The skills and agents call kb.mjs with the v1 surface: v2 must accept every invocation they use (grep .claude/ for `kb.mjs`).
